changes.title: New setting: allowNestedModelAccessUnderForceLogin

after.description: Self-hosted runner hosts only. Set to true to let a Claude Code started by a runner session's command use the runner's model access (--nested-model-access) when this machine's managed settings set forceLoginOrgUUID or forceLoginMethod. It asks the runner which organization the session owner's sign-in belongs to, and stops if the pin does not permit it or the runner does not answer. Without this key it is left signed out. Any program on the machine can pretend to be the runner, so with this key the pin is not a security boundary: set it on runner hosts only, never in a profile that reaches people's own computers. Honored only from this machine's own administrator sources (MDM, the managed settings file, or a policy helper that they name); ignored in server-managed, user, project, local and --settings sources.

# Check for rg availability
if ! hash rg 2>/dev/null && ! typeset -f rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  function rg {
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command rg ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
fi
# Shadow find/grep with embedded bfs/ugrep

# Shadow pkill to refuse patterns matching the CLI process
unalias pkill 2>/dev/null || true
function pkill {
  if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PID:-}" ] && [ -r "/proc/${CLAUDE_PID}/comm" ]; then
    local _cc_skip="" _cc_a
    local -a _cc_probe=()
    for _cc_a in ${1+"$@"}; do
      if [ -n "$_cc_skip" ]; then _cc_skip=""; continue; fi
      case "$_cc_a" in
        --signal) _cc_skip=1 ;;
        --signal=*|-e|--echo) ;;
        -[0-9]*) ;;
        -[PUGOF]?*) _cc_probe+=("$_cc_a") ;;
        -[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ][ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0-9]*) ;;
        *) _cc_probe+=("$_cc_a") ;;
